title: Ulla, Son of Rabbi Zakkai
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Yuchasin cites this name from [Chullin 52a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.52a.7). Hyman says it is indeed the reading of Rabbenu Gershom, Tosafot under Neekra and the Soncino printing. The ordinary reading, however, is “Ulla said in the name of Ben Zakkai,” which Hyman traces to Maharshal’s emendation. Hyman therefore considers Seder HaDorot’s criticism of Yuchasin unwarranted.

notes.text: The alternatives describe different structures: Ulla, son of Zakkai, or Ulla reporting Ben Zakkai. Hyman sides with Yuchasin against Seder HaDorot’s criticism.

[Tosafot](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Chullin.52a.21.1) gives Ulla son of Rabbi Zakkai. The main text of [Rabbenu Gershom](https://www.sefaria.org/Rabbeinu_Gershom_on_Chullin.52a.7) has Ulla son of Zakkai, with an accompanying note proposing a reading that restores “Ben Zakkai said.” [Maharshal](https://www.sefaria.org/Chokhmat_Shlomo_on_Chullin.52a.2) discusses both forms and attributes the patronymic to Rashi’s reading. The consulted Gemara has Ulla reporting Ben Zakkai. The Soncino reading follows Hyman.
